scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.render-build: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build || true
scripts.vercel-build: cd client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
